impact: onboard.ts calls synthesizePersona() which returns null if no API key. Falls back to buildPlainMarkdown() with no warning to the user. They get a worse PERSONA.md without knowing it and have no idea why Zug seems less capable.
resolution: onboard.ts now prints a visible warning when synthesis is skipped due to missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, explaining the degradation and telling the user to set the key for a richer fingerprint.
title: zug onboard silently degrades to plain markdown when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is missing
